verify_commands.dd_text: On a PR, the CodeQL job in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs to completion and produces a code-scanning analysis visible via the code-scanning API for that PR's head SHA
The code-scanning API reports at least the most recent CodeQL analysis for the repository after a PR run

verify_commands.command: gh api "/repos/$OWNER/$REPO/commits/$(gh api /repos/$OWNER/$REPO/pulls/$NOCODE_PR --jq .head.sha)/check-runs" --jq '[.check_runs[] | select(.name | test("CodeQL")) | select(.conclusion=="success" or .conclusion=="neutral")] | length' | awk '$1>=1{exit 0} {exit 1}'
verify_commands.dd_text: CodeQL job triggers on all pull_request events; a no-analyzable-code PR still reports a terminal CodeQL check conclusion rather than a missing required check
